facts.business: Lumax Industries Limited is an automotive lighting and illumination solutions provider for two-wheelers, four-wheelers, and farm equipment, offering design, development, and manufacturing of headlamps, tail lamps, and advanced lighting systems.
facts.related_party_note: The Company supplies its products directly to OEMs, which limits its ability to reclaim them at the end of their life cycle. However, it actively engages in the Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR) framework for plastics used in packaging and distribution processes.
